projects.title: XNIC v1
projects.description: Clean-room Intel 82540EM/e1000 PCI Ethernet driver lab in Linux C with BAR0 MMIO, DMA descriptor rings, NAPI, `ethtool` telemetry, fault injection, and reset recovery (technical docs). Also includes a W5500 SPI path and a gated DPDK L2 forwarder, keeping physical-silicon claims strictly out of scope until real hardware runs exist.

resume.objective: Build and qualify a defensible clean-room Linux Ethernet driver with observable packet paths, ownership invariants, fault recovery, and a gated user-space DPDK forwarding path.
approach: Implemented PCI probe/remove, BAR0 MMIO, coherent and streaming DMA rings, interrupt-driven NAPI, TX queue backpressure, ethtool counters, and serialized watchdog/reset recovery in C
Added staged fault injection, KFENCE and sparse qualification, reproducible QEMU/HVF automation, Wireshark-compatible captures, a W5500 SPI driver path, and an rte_ethdev L2 forwarder
resume.impact: Qualified 10,100 RX and TX ring wraps across 646,400 packets at zero loss, 1,000 interface cycles, 100 driver rebinds, and 100 reset-under-traffic cycles; validated DPDK partial-TX cleanup and signal-safe shutdown with the net_pcap virtual PMD.

projects.title: proofinfer
projects.description: Zero-dependency Llama inference engine in pure Rust built around proving correctness rather than assuming it. Differentially tested against PyTorch (`karpathy/llama2.c`) across 6 configs, byte-identical to `run.c`, mutation-tested on both harness and tests, and backed by a 36-VC Verus proof of KV-cache safety (technical docs).

resume.objective: Build a dependency-free Llama inference engine whose correctness is backed by independent evidence rather than claimed.
approach: Implemented Llama inference in pure Rust with an 8-lane dot product and no external crates
Verified it through PyTorch differential testing, byte-identical comparison against run.c, mutation testing of both harness and tests, and a Verus proof of KV-cache index safety
resume.impact: Passed 6/6 differential configurations at max error 1.0e-5 and 200/200 top-1 on real stories15M weights; caught 10/10 harness and 21/21 test-suite mutants; 36 Verus obligations verified with 0 errors; 835 tok/s single-threaded, 5.4x over the naive dot product.

projects.title: GSoC- SpliDT: Scaling Stateful Decision Tree Algorithms in P4
projects.description: Switch-native compiler framework for stateful decision tree inference directly inside Intel Tofino programmable switches, bringing real-time ML classification into the network data plane (codebase private due to research paper).

resume.objective: Compile machine-learning decision trees directly into P4 data planes using Partitioned Decision Trees.
approach: Architected a switch-native inference framework around Subtree ID recirculation
Automated P4Runtime validation across Tofino and Mininet test environments
resume.impact: Achieved 10 Gbps line-rate throughput and 5x lower latency than control-plane inference.

projects.title: hami-core-init-bench
projects.description: GPU-free C test bench reproducing concurrent `libvgpu.so` initialization contention for `Project-HAMi/HAMi#1662`. Links directly against real HAMi-core object files (`multiprocess_memory_limit.o`, `utils.o`) in Docker to benchmark shared-memory, semaphore, and procfs locking without an NVIDIA GPU.

resume.objective: Reproduce and benchmark HAMi-core concurrent initialization contention without requiring physical GPUs.
approach: Linked directly against HAMi-core object files inside Docker to exercise real shared-memory, semaphore, and procfs paths
resume.impact: Enables deterministic, GPU-free profiling and patch verification for Project-HAMi/HAMi#1662.

projects.title: Myprod
projects.description: Go CLI and operator dashboard turning free-tier and cheap VPS machines into a personal compute pool, with Nomad scheduling, Traefik ingress, WireGuard networking, idempotent Netlify DNS, and guarded node controls.

resume.objective: Turn manually provisioned VPS machines into a low-overhead personal compute pool for backend services.
approach: Built a Go CLI and operator dashboard around Nomad scheduling, Traefik ingress, and WireGuard networking
Added guarded node lifecycle controls, application registration, live resource metrics, and idempotent Netlify DNS management
resume.impact: Provides one control surface for deploying applications and managing heterogeneous free-tier and temporary compute capacity.

projects.title: SecondTrust
projects.description: One-command Windows, Linux, and macOS audit tool to verify a new or second-hand laptop before the return window closes. Checks invoice specs, Secure Boot/BIOS/MDM tampering, raw SSD power-on hours/TBW, battery wear, and CPU/RAM/VRAM stability under load.

resume.objective: Audit newly purchased or second-hand laptops for hardware authenticity, tampering, wear, and stability before the return window closes.
approach: Built cross-platform PowerShell and shell audit scripts reading firmware, SMART/NVMe wear, MDM enrollment, and memory/CPU/VRAM stress checks
Paired with an interactive web report viewer
resume.impact: Gives buyers a single repeatable hardware and tamper check across Windows, Linux, and macOS.

projects.title: LocalChat
projects.description: Single-binary, zero-dependency Go web chat and Android APK for personal devices over Tailscale, built because scanning WhatsApp Web every day got old. Uses ~8.5 MB RAM open (0 MB idle after 5 min auto-shutdown), syncs offline queues across devices, and streams 250 MB uploads with HTTP `Range` media playback.

resume.objective: Sync personal messages, code snippets, and large files across personal devices over Tailscale without cloud accounts or background daemons.
approach: Built a zero-dependency Go binary and Android wrapper with per-device local storage, explicit offline delivery queue, and streamed 250 MB uploads
resume.impact: Replaces cloud self-messaging with an 8.5 MB active / 0 MB idle self-hosted chat tool across desktop and mobile.

projects.title: Cutable
projects.description: Agentic software-engineering workspace turning prompts and visual references into editable React apps. A Go backend streams planning, tool calls, builds, and live previews from isolated E2B sandboxes over WebSockets while persisting projects in PostgreSQL.

resume.objective: Generate editable React applications from text and visual requirements.
approach: Orchestrated OpenRouter tools and E2B sandboxes in Go
Streamed code and live previews to Next.js over WebSockets
resume.impact: Ships multimodal BYOK generation, persistent projects, and health-gated deployments.

projects.title: ebpf-mcp-tracer
projects.description: Guarded MCP server letting LLMs write and run `bpftrace` scripts against Linux kernels behind an explicit probe allowlist, blocked dangerous builtins, dry-run validation, and hard execution timeouts.

resume.objective: Let AI debugging agents inspect Linux performance without granting unrestricted eBPF execution.
approach: Implemented a strict probe allowlist, dry-run validation, and execution timeouts around bpftrace
Exposed the guarded tracing workflow through MCP
resume.impact: Enables kernel-level diagnostics while reducing command-injection and runaway-probe risk.

projects.title: Do-It
projects.description: Self-hosted Go binary (SSE/HTTP) for Raspberry Pi, routers, or spare phones, syncing notes, tasks, and media across every device on your local home Wi-Fi with zero cloud accounts.

resume.objective: Provide private, synchronized notes and media across devices on a local network.
approach: Packaged a lightweight Go SSE and HTTP server for Raspberry Pi, routers, and repurposed phones
resume.impact: Delivers self-hosted, account-free synchronization without sending household data to a cloud service.

projects.title: p4Lens
projects.description: Interactive P4-14/P4-16 program visualizer that parses headers, parsers, controls, and deparsers into a React Flow pipeline diagram for learning and debugging P4Lang.

resume.objective: Make P4 programs easier to learn and debug through an interactive visualization of their processing pipeline.
approach: Built a parser for P4-14 and P4-16 programs
Rendered headers, parsers, controls, and deparsers as interactive React Flow topologies
resume.impact: Renders pipeline diagrams in under 200 ms and reduces control-plane debugging effort by approximately 40 percent.

projects.title: Moodish
projects.description: Mood-based meal planner on the Swiggy MCP taking cravings, budget, and diet constraints to return ranked meal options with a transparent AI summary, recommendation trace, and confirmation-gated cart preview.

resume.objective: Rank meal options from a user's craving, budget, and dietary constraints while keeping the recommendation explainable.
approach: Built intent extraction and deterministic ranking around an AI-generated summary
Added a recommendation trace and confirmation-gated cart preview
resume.impact: Produces safer, inspectable food recommendations instead of opaque model output.

projects.title: Open Claw Lab
projects.description: Oracle Cloud-hosted multi-agent career intelligence pipeline that finds engineering roles, filters every lead through deterministic evidence gates and independent review, and sends a verified Telegram digest without automated outreach.

resume.objective: Discover high-signal engineering opportunities while preventing unsupported or stale leads from reaching the user.
approach: Built a multi-agent discovery and independent-review pipeline around typed lead records
Added deterministic freshness, eligibility, contact relevance, relocation evidence, and deduplication gates
resume.impact: Delivers an evidence-backed Telegram digest while rejecting guessed contacts, unsupported geography, stale roles, and duplicate leads.

projects.title: Los-Tecnicos
projects.description: Decentralized energy grid on Stellar turning solar power into tokenized assets and stable income (Go backend, 4 Soroban smart contracts, Raspberry Pi + ESP32 hardware mesh). Built during the Stellar McLeod Residency.

resume.objective: Build a decentralized energy grid that tokenizes renewable-energy production on the Stellar ecosystem.
approach: Built a Go backend and 4 Soroban smart contracts
Integrated a Raspberry Pi/ESP32 hardware mesh with the platform
resume.impact: Won Asia-Pacific Web3 bounties and received recognition from the Government of India.

projects.title: DMIE
projects.description: Checks if your startup idea already exists with competitor analysis built over 500,000+ scraped Indian startups. Private repo built in collab with a cracked dev friend of mine.

resume.objective: Determine whether a startup idea already exists by comparing it against more than 500,000 company records.
approach: Built a scheduled scraper that keeps the startup dataset current
Combined LLM query with vector search and backend filters
resume.impact: Raised USD 10,000 and serves more than 100 users worldwide.

projects.title: Slix
projects.description: Full-stack React + Go movie streaming and review platform using Azure OpenAI sentiment analysis on curator reviews so viewers get the movie vibe at a glance.

resume.objective: Combine movie streaming, reviews, and machine-generated sentiment summaries in one full-stack application.
approach: Built the frontend in React and the service layer in Go
Added Azure OpenAI sentiment analysis for curator reviews
resume.impact: Gives viewers a concise representation of a movie's tone before watching.
